name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.37.1 — review-fix on specs/20260825/01: the retired genesis panel's last references are cleared from the one workflow that survived (`wf-research.js`'s `meta.description` and its dissent-flag comment) and from `genesis.md` § Genesis: Executed Assumptions. The AC-20260825-01-2 literal ban gains bare `panel` and extends its sweep to `wf-research.js`, closing the blind spot that let these through — `pipelineOwnedPaths` (`spec/workflows/wf-*.js`) prunes that file from collision-closure's literals leg and scope-reconcile alike, so the enumerated-file test is the only gate that can see it. 7.37.0 — Gotchas cap becomes a driver-enforced ratchet, never a CLOSE-step sentence: `prose-cap.js --baseline N` admits an over-cap section iff strictly smaller than N; the review driver records the verdict-time count on the review row (`gotchas`), prints it in the CLOSE step, and refuses `--mark closed` while an over-cap section has not shrunk (hosts without a pipelineRules file are skipped, row unchanged). Fixes the flag-day adoption gate measured at Upwell (138/15) and Prax (169/15, closed 2026-08-25 with the cap unmet by founder ruling); bulk pruning stays direct host work. review.md/escape.md name the ratchet. 7.36.0 — genesis panel collapse: one proposer over the research fan-out (specs/20260825/01-genesis-panel-collapse.md): the genesis MoA panel is deleted — `spec/workflows/wf-panel.js` (three blind Sonnet proposers plus a Fable aggregator), its `spec-paths wf-panel` key, and its `entrypoints.json` row are gone. `wf-research.js` (one Sonnet agent per dimension slice, web-enabled) is retained and is now the only workflow genesis calls: the planning session itself is the one proposer — it reads every `interview-research/{dimension}.json` on disk and writes the decision record directly into the ADRs, escalating a hard fork (two menu options within one rank of each other, or a user hesitation signal) as an `AskUserQuestion` built from the menu. A second perspective on a hard fork is a second `wf-research` call over a different `dimensionKeys` slice — partitioned evidence, never a second agent reading the same brief. `genesis.md` drops its `Session ↔ Workflow Loop`, `The MoA Panel`, and `Research-Angle & Role Menus` sections for one new `Genesis: Decision Record (one proposer)` section; `Panel Roles` and `panel-results-{stage}.json` are retired from the on-disk handoff. The Archetype Registry table shrinks to `Archetype | Hard-to-reverse dimension keys (floor) | Design stage` — no framework, language, runtime, or catalog product named in doctrine, and `rendering strategy` leaves the architect floor. `spec/commands/genesis-architect.md` and `spec/commands/genesis-design.md` are rewritten to match (Setup, the derive/decide phases, Rules), and `spec/templates/adr.md`'s `Deciders` line and `Dissents` literal are updated with them.
